svg.title: Input and response coverage
svg.desc: Each point is a complete exported record. Other inputs may vary; this is not a controlled response curve. Filled points are training records; hollow points are other declared groups. Surrogate means are not new native runs or uncertainty intervals.
svg.metadata: {"chart":"coverage","profile_id":"htl-reference-hr","model_sha256":"0ae413ef6cb13ac09abccdb37d060103eb94b4488b65310e8eadef3d1d6903bf","dataset_sha256":"90fa8bfcc9b276640a291172e5bd2adb942f8877fd5756439f6cda58ebb420c1","profile_sha256":"07f292a36262a52104a565b981a904cd0129e33b965c782824db466d170e02be","source_evidence_type":"native_simulation","native_model_sha256":"4c93329ad8d44a44857ee63e18b4a1567aa7762aa1c4b9929b09d325e7021bed","model_scope":"Mean-only interpolation inside declared bounds and actual training convex hull. No uncertainty bands, live Aspen execution or physical validation.","declared_prediction_enabled":true,"declared_qualification_status":"declared_simulator_error_checks_passed","exploratory":false,"plotted_records":37,"retained_records_not_plotted":0,"input":"reactor_temperature_K","input_unit":"K","response":"purchased_energy_kWh_kg","response_unit":"kWh/kg","functional_unit":"1 kg declared target product","system_boundary":"Inherited HTL fixed-background accounting: feed, heater/reactor electricity, fixed pump inventory, direct CO2/CH4 and wastewater; excludes separator heat duty and cooling-service burdens; not a full-plant utility inventory","source_note":"Per-record source identities and full numerical precision are retained in the accompanying CSV. Missing records remain in the original artifact. Declared hashes and qualification are not independently authenticated by this browser export."}

svg.text: Each point is a complete exported record. Other inputs may vary; this is not a controlled response
curve. Filled points are training records; hollow points are other declared groups. Surrogate
means are not new native runs or uncertainty intervals.
model_scope: Mean-only interpolation inside declared bounds and actual training convex hull. No
uncertainty bands, live Aspen execution or physical validation.
system_boundary: Inherited HTL fixed-background accounting: feed, heater/reactor electricity,
fixed pump inventory, direct CO2/CH4 and wastewater; excludes separator heat duty and
cooling-service burdens; not a full-plant utility inventory
source_note: Per-record source identities and full numerical precision are retained in the
accompanying CSV. Missing records remain in the original artifact. Declared hashes and
qualification are not independently authenticated by this browser export.
